_about: Every New Hampshire street that carries house numbers, by town and ZIP code: the list the Your town panel's address box suggests from. Written by src/towns/parse_tiger_streets.py from the Census Bureau's TIGER/Line files; its docstring says how. Each row is street, town, ZIP, house numbers: space-separated runs, each of only odd or only even numbers, "1-299 2-298". Public domain, as its source is.

source.files: https://www2.census.gov/geo/tiger/TIGER2026/ -- ADDRFEAT and FACES for each of the ten counties, COUSUB for the state
